scripts.typecheck: for p in shared relay daemon plugin kilo; do tsc -p packages/$p || exit 1; done
scripts.build: npm run build -w @handoff/daemon && npm run build -w @handoff/opencode-plugin && npm run build -w @handoff/kilo-plugin
scripts.package:plugin: npm run build -w @handoff/opencode-plugin && mkdir -p dist && tar -C packages/plugin/dist/handoff -czf dist/handoff-plugin.tar.gz .
scripts.package:kilo: npm run build -w @handoff/kilo-plugin && mkdir -p dist && cp packages/kilo/dist/handoff.js dist/handoff-kilo.js
